key_insight: FormalAnalyticGeo uses a neural-symbolic pipeline to automatically create high-precision multimodal analytic geometry problems with aligned text, diagrams, formal constraints, and verified answers.
engineering_relevance: It provides a scalable data-generation framework that can reduce manual annotation bottlenecks for training and evaluating multimodal math reasoning systems.
method: Generator creates diverse analytic geometry problems.
Formalizer converts problems into CDL for SDF-based diagram rendering.
Measurer and Quality Verifier iteratively check and correct outputs in a closed loop.
evidence_signal: The resulting AnalyticGeo7K dataset contains over 7K verified problems, with a median ground-truth relative error of 0.70% and 82.3% of answers within 5% of the exact symbolic solution.
watch_item: The approach depends on robust formal conversion and vision-based measurement; errors in CDL translation, rendering, or verification could still propagate despite the retry loop.
paper_title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
